title: Why Is Thanksgiving Turkey So Cheap?
description:
Wholesale turkey runs about $1.80 a pound this fall, yet Target sells its frozen turkey for 79 cents, because grocery stores use the bird as a loss leader to win the rest of your cart.
#thanksgiving #turkey #money #shorts

Sources: Texas A&M via Farm Progress (Nov 9, 2026) and Feedstuffs (Nov 5, 2026); The Shelby Report citing USDA (Nov 13, 2026); NBC Chicago (Nov 12, 2026); Axios (Nov 15, 2025); Scripps News (Nov 19, 2025); Daily Voice via AOL (2025)
Photos: Anthony Quintano, Phillip Pessar, BruceTurner (CC BY 2.0, Flickr); sarahstierch (CC0, Flickr)

scenes.say: Your {79¢|seventy nine cent} turkey costs the store {$1.80|a dollar eighty}.
scenes.source: Farm Progress Nov 9 2026 + Feedstuffs Nov 5 2026 (Texas A&M's David Anderson: late October wholesale whole turkeys averaged $1.80 per pound); Shelby Report Nov 13 2026 (USDA: frozen basted hens $1.81 a pound week of Nov 2-6); NBC Chicago Nov 12 2026 + Shelby Report Nov 13 2026 (Target Good & Gather frozen turkey 79 cents per pound)

scenes.say: Target charges {79¢|seventy nine cents} a pound. Stores pay {$1.80|a dollar eighty} for it, wholesale.
scenes.source: Farm Progress Nov 9 2026 + Feedstuffs Nov 5 2026 (Texas A&M's David Anderson: late October wholesale whole turkeys averaged $1.80 per pound); Shelby Report Nov 13 2026 (USDA: frozen basted hens $1.81 a pound week of Nov 2-6); Target 79 cents: NBC Chicago Nov 12 2026, Shelby Report Nov 13 2026 (third straight year)

scenes.say: Walmart? {97¢|Ninety seven cents} for a Butterball.
scenes.source: NBC Chicago Nov 12 2026 (Butterball turkey priced at 97 cents per pound in Walmart's meal basket); Shelby Report Nov 13 2026 (Walmart kept Butterball at 97 cents a pound, unchanged from 2025)

scenes.say: So stores lose money on the bird. On purpose.
scenes.source: Axios Nov 15 2025 (many retailers selling turkeys at or below cost to draw shoppers in for higher-margin items); Daily Voice via AOL 2025 (stores may actually lose money on each bird sold); arithmetic: 79 cents retail vs ~$1.80 wholesale

scenes.say: Some stores even give the turkey away free, once you spend enough.
scenes.source: Shelby Report Nov 13 2026 (BJ's free Butterball after a $150 spend Oct 31-Nov 9; ShopRite free turkey tied to Price Plus spend; Giant/Martin's for points); GMA 2025 + BJ's press release Oct 30 2025 (free Butterball for members who spend $150+)

scenes.say: The turkey industry's own trade group says turkeys are kind of the loss leader on the Thanksgiving table.

visual.quote: Turkeys are kind of the loss leader on the Thanksgiving table.

scenes.source: Axios Nov 15 2025, verbatim quote from Leslee Oden, National Turkey Federation president and CEO; loss-leader framing also in Scripps News Nov 19 2025

scenes.say: Because nobody walks out with just a turkey.
scenes.source: Scripps News Nov 19 2025 (grocery chains discount turkeys to draw shoppers, then make up sales on other products); Daily Voice via AOL 2025 (to bring customers in for other purchases)

scenes.say: They make it back on the pie, the wine, the decorations.
scenes.source: Axios Nov 15 2025 (higher-margin items like wine, desserts and decor)

scenes.say: So grab the cheap bird, and stick to your list. Because
